name: Brightscale Keep
blurb: A sleepy castle town of banners, bees and bad jousting. Every snake starts here.

currency.name: Snaycoin
currency.tale: Struck in the castle forge from melted-down horseshoes and lost jousting trophies. They say a Snaycoin always lands tails up, just to be contrary.

merchant.name: Sir Hissington
merchant.line: Steel for scales, friend. Nothing in my forge is perfect, but all of it is honest.

challenger.name: Lady Vexa
challenger.line: Three trials, one week, no excuses. The crowd adores a snake who sweats.

banker.name: Old Moneyfang
banker.line: Coins in, gems out, a small fee for my trouble. My trouble is very small. My fee is not.

boss.name: Grimscale the Black Knight
boss.taunt: None shall pass. Especially not you.

arrive.title: A snake arrives at Brightscale Keep

levels.name: The Village Green
levels.text: Snake the way it has always been: no walls, no hazards, just you and the apples. Eat 10.

levels.name: Castle Yard
levels.text: Now there are walls, and they mean it. Reach 1,500 points.

levels.name: The Pillared Hall
levels.text: Stone pillars hold up the roof and get in your way. Mind the rocks. Eat 14 apples.

levels.name: Frostkeep Cellar
levels.text: The cellar is chilly and the popsicles are not food. Grow to 22 long.

levels.name: Lair: The First Hunt
levels.text: Grimscale rides out. You cannot hurt him yet, but you can outlast him. Dodge until his stamina runs dry.

levels.name: Flea Market
levels.text: Fleas everywhere, haggling and biting. Eat 16 apples.

levels.name: The Apiary Gate
levels.text: The royal bees guard the gate and chase anything that moves. Reach 3,500.

levels.name: Jousting Lists
levels.text: Survive one minute on the tourney grounds while fleas and bees joust for your tail.

levels.name: Watchtower Ring
levels.text: Find three tower keys, then reach the gate they open.

levels.name: Lair: The Armored Duel
levels.text: Grimscale's silver plate turns teeth. Drain him until he slows, then bite his body to crack the armor.

levels.name: The King's Road
levels.text: The road never ends, and neither does the screen. Ride it 220 meters.

levels.name: The Hedge Maze
levels.text: Somewhere in the royal hedges lies the Lost Crown. Find it. The arrow at the side shows the way.

levels.name: Hall of Plates
levels.text: An endless hall of mirrored walls. Step on all four pressure plates and the great seal appears.

levels.name: The Shifting Bailey
levels.text: The castle walls rise and fall on a timer. Watch for the glow. Eat 18 apples.

levels.name: Lair: The Last Stand
levels.text: No armor left, nowhere to hide. Exhaust him and bite until his heart gives out.
